newsitem.title: JAPAN: SHARES OF SHOWA ALUMINIUM HIT HIGH FOR 1997.
newsitem.headline: SHARES OF SHOWA ALUMINIUM HIT HIGH FOR 1997.

text.p: Shares of Showa Aluminium Corp hit a calender year high on Tuesday afternoon on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, traders said.
Showa Aluminium's shares had risen 17 yen to 711 yen by 0536 GMT, surpassing the previous high of 700 yen.
Shares of the aluminium processing company marked a previous calendar year high of 700 yen on August 8.
"The company's sales of electronics products are smoothly expanding. The market views it favourably that the company is changing into an electronics parts maker," one trader said.
While the share was not particularly cheap it could rise further given the market's bearish overall sentiment, traders said.
